scope: Bounded force PI commissioning hypothesis, not verified hardware capacity

derivation.equal_wheel_output_torque_formula: mu * mass_kg * gravity * wheelbase_m * tire_radius_m / (4 * track_m)
derivation.gain_selection: Keep P12 and4Nm total clamp. Add I4 with an integral-output clamp of +/-1Nm to compensate persistent velocity error under lateral Coulomb load; PI integral time is3s, comparable to the unchanged turn interval. This is a documented controller revision, not a tolerance change.
derivation.hardware_caveat: 4Nm remains an estimated simulation hypothesis; continuous motor torque, thermal capacity, gearbox efficiency and actual tire friction are not validated.
